cases.title: Brief for URL-persisted filters on the /agents page
cases.input:
Write a task brief I can hand to Codex.

Repo: Agent Archive (github.com/yohan-work/agentive). Next.js 16 App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind, `output: "export"` static build deployed to GitHub Pages. No middleware, no server-side searchParams — query strings must be read on the client with useSearchParams. Pages live under src/app/[locale]/ (en, ko).

Goal: persist the /agents page filters in the URL so a filtered view can be shared and survives reload. Today only `?query=` is read (seeded once into the search box); role, category, difficulty, automation level, tool, verified status, and "installable only" live in React state and are lost on reload.

Files involved:
- src/components/agents/agent-search-panel.tsx — client component, holds `query` and `filters` (type AgentFilters) in useState; exports AgentSearchPanel and AgentSearchPanelFromUrl (the latter reads `?query=` via useSearchParams and passes initialQuery).
- src/lib/search.ts — `AgentFilters` type, `searchAgents`, `filterAgents`, `getUniqueTools`.
- src/app/[locale]/agents/page.tsx — renders `<Suspense fallback={<AgentSearchPanel .../>}><AgentSearchPanelFromUrl .../></Suspense>`.
- src/components/layout/top-nav.tsx — the header search navigates to /agents?query=...
- tests/search.test.ts — node:test suite run with `npm test` (tsx loader).
- src/i18n/dictionaries.ts — any new UI string needs both en and ko.

Constraints:
- Keep the static export working (`npm run build` must still produce out/ with no dynamic server usage).
- Use router.replace (no new history entry per click) and don't scroll to top on filter change.
- Unknown or invalid param values (e.g. ?difficulty=expertish, ?automation=9) must be ignored, not crash.
- The top-nav search must keep working and must not wipe other active filters.
- No new dependencies.

Acceptance criteria:
- Selecting filters updates the URL, e.g. /en/agents?role=developer&difficulty=advanced&installable=1
- Loading that URL directly shows the same filtered result and highlighted chips.
- "Clear all" removes all params; "Clear filters only" keeps ?query=.
- Unit tests cover parse/serialize of filters, including invalid values.
- `npm run check:data`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` all pass.

Non-goals: saving filters to localStorage, changing the search ranking, adding new filter types.
